source_description: Unique business identifier of the report
Report identifier for the supplier's internal business
comment: Additional identifier with the supplier's own system (identifier slicing is open).

source_description: Period covered by the report (typically 14 to 30 days)
comment: effective[x] is restricted to Period; start and end are both mandatory.
The model carries the NISS; in FHIR it is the identifier of the referenced patient (or Reference.identifier). Unlike the observation profile, subject is not restricted to BePatient.

source_description: Service provider or organization that encodes the information
comment: The model carries the NISS of the professional or the company number of the organization; in FHIR this is a reference to the corresponding practitioner, practitioner role or organization.

source_description: Service provider or organization that collects the observations and produces the report
comment: Not constrained in the profile. For the diabetes report, performer = recorder.

source_description: Care provider who interprets the observations in the report
comment: Reference(BePractitionerRole | BePractitioner). Not provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.
No element in the profile carries the diabetes category. It is calculated from the diagnosis by the interpreting doctor (default CAT 3) and is also used in Observation.referenceRange.appliesTo.

source_description: Identification number assigned by INAMI to the sensor type
comment: The INAMI sensor type number is sent as a code with system be-ns-diabetes-device-type.
Bound to BeVSDiabetesReportCode (e.g. 439926003 Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid).

source_description: References to the derived value observations in the report
References to the blood glucose measurement observations used to produce the analysis
comment: No element in the profile. DiagnosticReport.result is restricted to BeObservationDiabetes (derived values), so the individual measurements are not referenced from the report.

source_description: Problem related to this diagnostic report
comment: No element in the R4 profile. The R5 DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo cross-version extension was considered but is commented out in the profile.
Not provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.

source_description: PDF document containing the complete report

comment: Bound to BeVSDiabetesReportStatus. The status depends on the business rule on % Data Captured.
